title: 2D Offset: three lateral rapids run below the clearance plane through uncut stock, with Hop below clearance off

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
The maintainer reported this in chat on 2026-11-22 and asked for a P1 bug. His words:

> explpain these two errors.. travels.. should never be anywhere but at clearance plane.. so why does it do G0s below it?

and then: "file that as a P1 Bug."

## What happens

A 2D Offset operation generates rapid moves (G0) that run sideways below the clearance plane. They cross stock that is still uncut. The operation page shows this warning:

`rapid move 543 travels through stock (below the clearance plane, or at it below the stock top) - repeated on 2 more moves (to 1711)`

So three lateral rapids (move 543 up to move 1711) are below the clearance plane.

## Expected

"Hop below clearance" is off. The Heights tab says: "off, every link climbs to Clearance Z". Every lateral rapid then rides at the clearance plane (Z 32.000 here). No rapid runs sideways through stock.

## Evidence

- Build v0.25.0, commit 7e2a8119. The maintainer sent screenshots. They are not attached here.
- Operation `2D Offset1`: tool `EM-0800-4FL` (Ø8), model `fig8`, Setup1, VMC 3-AXIS, Siemens 840D. The Outside containment is the same as in #3316.
- Heights tab: Clearance Z = Top of stock +10 (Z 32.000). Top Z = Top of stock +0 (Z 22.000). Bottom Z = Selection +1.5 (Z 1.500). Stepdown 10 mm. "Hop below clearance" off.
- Lead in / Lead out tab: Level to level "Same as entry". Between levels "Clearance plane". Between passes "Retract plane". Plunge "Height above material" 2.0 mm. Entry Helix, radius 1.6 mm.
- Status: `OK - 1764 moves - 2 warnings`. The second warning is `move 522 cuts past the finish surface - repeated on 62 more moves (to 1710)`.

## What the code says (read by the coordinator on 2026-11-22)

- With the hop off, `retract_z` is `None`. Then `levels.rs:179` sets `hop_z = retract_z.unwrap_or(clearance_z).min(clearance_z)`. A link with the choice "Retract plane" lifts to the clearance plane (Z 32). There is no hidden retract plane (see #3318).
- So the three lateral rapids below Z 32 do not come from a pass link. Their source is not known. The worker finds it.

## Safety

The verifier flags these rapids and the post is blocked, so no wrong program is posted today. A rapid through stock is the failure that the verifier exists to stop. The generator must not make one. The priority is P1 on the word of the maintainer.

## Possible links

- #3316: the same operation. Its cause is the ring order: `waterscan.rs:115` sorts the rings core-first, so on an Outside band the first ring of each level is a full slot in the stock. The three rapids may be the jumps between rings that this order makes.
- #3318: the retract plane that the user cannot see. That answer is in this issue.
- #2121 (closed): a clearance plane set inside the stock. Not this case: here the clearance plane is above the stock top.

Done means: a pin test on `fig8.step` with `EM-0800-4FL` and these heights shows no lateral rapid below the clearance plane through stock, with "Hop below clearance" off; the verifier gives no `travels through stock` warning; every shipped golden is byte-identical; an independent Opus read and a hand trace of the three rapids.
